title: Australian man records astronaut private channel

tellings.quote: Um who the hell did we meet? some guy from Australia that um had been recording and when they switched to a different channel, he was able to switch

plain: A man in Australia is said to have recorded astronauts' radio, and when they switched to a different, private channel, he could switch along with them and keep listening. Charlie Foltz, a guest on an episode about alien abductions, recalls meeting this man but cannot remember who he was. If true, the man may have heard things the astronauts said off the public line.
